title: What's New in 1.2.0
summary: HUGE UPDATE! Two brand-new tools have landed in this release: Family Library and ReNumber!
content:
Two brand-new tools have landed in this release!

Family Library: Store, browse and preview your families, templates and detail items without leaving Revit. Search by name or #tag, load straight into your project or load and place, build your own palettes of favourites, and share a library with your team.

ReNumber: Number elements your way with reusable rules. Combine several categories in one rule, set a target parameter for each, add optional family-type filters, and build numbers from Constant / Increment / Field parts. Duplicate, edit, import and export rules whenever you like.

Expert Sheets: choose any DWG/DXF export setup stored in your project right from the Format tab. If your project has none, a plain A2Z Default setup is created for you.

Additional purge parameters added to Package Up.
Additional tools added to the Revision Manager.
